label: Cadbury Dairy Milk
note: Launched June 1905 in Birmingham; British milk chocolate is made with chocolate crumb, which gives a slightly cooked, caramel taste (Maillard); 1928 slogan "a glass and a half" of milk

about.text: British milk chocolate bar launched in 1905 by George Cadbury Jr, made with milk crumb; the UK's best-selling bar in 2014.
